question: In January 2023, who among the following has been appointed as the new Vice-Chief of the Indian Air Force?
solution:
​The correct answer is __A.P. Singh.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] In News__

__
 
• Air Marshal A.P. Singh to be the new Vice Chief of the Indian Air Force.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• ​He will succeed Air Marshal Sandeep Singh.
 
• A P Singh is currently serving as the Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief of the Central Air Command.
 
• He will take charge as the Vice Chief on 1 February 2023.
 
• He was commissioned into the fighter stream of the IAF in December 1984.
 
• He is an alumnus of the National Defence Academy, Defence Services Staff College and National Defence College. 
 
• He is a Qualified Flying Instructor and an Experimental Test Pilot with more than 4,900 hours of service flying on a variety of fixed-wing and rotary-wing aircraft.
 
• He also led the MiG 29 Upgrade Project Management Team in Moscow, Russia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Recent Defence-related Appointments:

 
 
• Retired director general of the Border Security Force (BSF) Pankaj Kumar Singh was appointed on 17 January as the Deputy National Security Adviser for a period of two years.
 
• Air Marshal Pankaj Mohan assumed command of the IAF Western Command on 1 January 2023.
 
• Lieutenant General Arvind Walia has been appointed as the next Engineer-in-Chief of the Indian Army on 27 December 2022.
 
 
 
• Indian Air Force:
 
 
• IAF was established in 1932 during World War II to support Royal Air Force of the United Kingdom in its war against Japan.
 
• The President of India is the Supreme Commander of Armed Forces.
 
• IAF is the 4th-largest air force in the world.
 
• Headquarters: New Delhi
 
• Motto: Touch the sky with Glory.
 
• Chief of Air Staff, an air chief marshal is responsible for operational command of the air force.
